nd.screen.hint: The native desktop on the monitor plugged into this server.
nd.full.hint: A real desktop: the NoCapOS sign-in screen, a dock with Files, Settings, Software, Terminal, Text Editor and a web browser, and your Linux apps. Sign in with this server's Linux accounts.
nd.off.hint: The text console only. Nothing graphical runs on this server.
nd.status.stopped: On, but not running right now
nd.noScreen: No screen detected right now. Plug one in to use NoCap Desktop.
nd.notSetUp: NoCap Desktop isn't set up on this server.
nd.confirmBody: Anyone signed in on the server's screen is signed out, and unsaved work there is lost.
nd.autologin.hint: The server's screen opens your desktop without a password after it starts. Anyone at the screen can use it.
nd.open.hint: See and use the server's screen right here, in a window. It always shows what the screen shows: sign in here and you're signed in on the screen too.
nd.win.signIn: Sign-in screen. Signing in here signs in on the server's screen too
nd.win.switching: Following the screen to its new session…
nd.win.closedBody: The screen was disconnected. The desktop may have restarted or signed out.
nd.win.title: The server's screen
nd.health.ok: NoCap Desktop is on the screen
nd.health.broken: Problem found: the screen may be black
nd.health.p.not_at_boot: The sign-in screen is not set to start when the server boots.
nd.health.p.not_graphical: The server boots to the text console instead of the desktop.
nd.health.p.dm_stopped: The sign-in screen is not running.
nd.health.p.dm_failed: The sign-in screen failed and stopped.
nd.health.p.no_shell: The sign-in screen is running, but GNOME Shell did not start (this causes a black screen).
nd.health.p.no_session: The NoCapOS session files are missing.
nd.health.p.no_xorg: Xorg is not installed, so there is no fallback if Wayland cannot run on this graphics card.
nd.health.p.kiosk_left: Parts of the old web full screen are still installed.
nd.health.p.services_held: The installer left services on hold.
nd.health.fallback.xorg: Using Xorg instead of Wayland so that it works on this graphics card.
nd.health.fallback.software: Using Xorg with software rendering and the standard sign-in theme so that it works on this machine.
nd.repair.hint: Fixes the boot setup, restores missing session files, removes old leftovers and, if the screen stays black, switches to a setup that works on this machine. The screen then restarts.
nd.repair.confirmBody: The server's screen will restart. Anyone signed in there will be signed out and unsaved work there will be lost.
nd.repair.done: NoCap Desktop was repaired; the screen is restarting
nd.diag.hint: Logs for the screen: sign-in screen, GNOME Shell, sessions and graphics card. Copy them when you ask for help.
